thread.title: FAANG Cracks: Facebook, Alphabet, Apple Outperform Amazon, Netflix

author: Tiernan Ray
title: FAANG Cracks: Facebook, Alphabet, Apple Outperform Amazon, Netflix
text:
As the market submerges once again on inflation worries, some large-cap tech names are holding up better than others.
In particular, the F.A.N.G gang — Facebook ( FB ), Amazon ( AMZN ), Alphabet ( GOOGL ) and Netflix ( NFLX ), but also sometimes including Apple ( AAPL ) — is breaking apart.
Apple’s actually rising, and Facebook and Alphabet are down not much more than the overall market, but Amazon and Netflix are taking it harder.
The Nasdaq is currently down $111.70, or 1.6%, at 6,940.28, after earlier going as low as 6,861.03, a 2.7% drop.
Facebook is down $3.38, or 1.9%, at $176.80; Amazon is down $28.68, or 2%, at $1,388.10; Alphabet is down $18.02, or 1.7%, at $1,037.39; Netflix is down $5.92, or 2.2%, at $258.64; and Apple is up 38 cents at $159.92.
You who’s getting hit hard are the cloud computing software darlings, which actually held up well on Monday amidst the rout.
Workday ( WDAY ) is down $4.48, or 3.8%, at $113.29, and Salesforce ( CRM ) is off $3.53, or 3.2%, at $106.52.
